verdict.rationale: Codex CLI is documented as a coding agent that runs locally on your computer, installed via npm or a standalone installer. It works against the local repository from the terminal: it inspects files, edits code and runs installed tools. Community hands-on reports of using it in the Codex CLI corroborate this.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run a coding agent locally from my terminal

citations.quote: Codex CLI is a coding agent from OpenAI that runs locally on your computer.
Inspect code, make changes, run commands, and automate repeatable work without leaving your terminal.
Work against your local repository: Let Codex inspect files, make edits, and run the tools already installed on your machine.
First thoughts using gpt-5.3-codex-spark in Codex CLI
